text: 1. Application Form 2. A clearly scanned copy of the personal information page on the valid passport in color 3. A clearly scanned copy of the Bachelor's degree certificates 4. A scanned copy of the academic transcript for the Bachelor degree during the entire study period 5. CV 6. Study plan and personal statement 7. Proof of Chinese or English proficiency (HSK; IELTS, TOEFL, Duolinguo, SAT, GRE and other proofs of English proficiency) 8. Physical Examination Certificate issued within the last 6 months 9. Non-criminal record certificate issued within last 5 months 10. Two ‘Recommendation Letters’ from Professors or Associate Professors 11. Financial Supporter Form and Bank Deposit Statement 12. Notarized copies of other awards or academic achievements. 13. Digital signature 14. Self-introduction video in Chinese or English
